name: player_apply_amphib_speed_oscillation
description: Player::ApplyAmphibSpeedOscillation applies modal pitch/roll wave oscillation to the caller-provided amphib up vector, with optional yaw-rate coupling.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent Player amphib/master-type class pass.
Binary Ninja reconstruction for 0x429240 remains limited by reused stack slots and x87 status-word rendering; assembly validates the inlined Euler-basis source shape.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x429240 validates the fastcall saveState/up-vector ABI plus stack includeYawCoupling argument, speed-absolute wave arguments from PlayerMasterModalData offsets 0x238..0x250, optional angVelYaw/localVel.z roll coupling, steerBasisNorm-derived yaw sine/cosine, inlined Euler-basis construction, and final vector multiply back into the caller-provided zVec3.
